home.intro: Wu Wei Kung Fu is an authentic system of Chinese martial arts built on the Taoist philosophy of 'non-action'. Founded by Sifu Ehsan Shayanfar, this style is his own creation and has been taught by him in Iran with over 25 years of experience.
home.philosophy: In Chinese thought, Wu Wei means deliberate, measured action and the avoidance of futile struggle. Wu Wei means remaining calm during the hardest tasks so they are performed with the greatest skill and efficiency. Wu Wei means embracing moderation and balance (the law of Yin-Yang). Wu Wei means being as flexible and yielding as water, yet powerful and surging like a torrent.
home.layers: The Three Layers of the Journey
home.layer1d: Not muscle alone; inner power — a will that rises from the Dantian and moves mountains
home.layer2d: Balance of body, mind and spirit — standing at the storm's center, calm as water
home.layer3d: The fruit of power and balance — an inner change that turns the student into a master of life
home.bookDesc: "Qigong the Authentic Chinese Kung Fu Way (Wu Wei)" by Sifu Ehsan Shayanfar explores the art of electromagnetic energy, corrective movements, acupressure and massage therapy.

about.title: About Us
about.sifuRole: Founder & Head of the Wu Wei Kung Fu Style
about.sifuBio: Sifu Ehsan Shayanfar, founder and head of the Wu Wei Kung Fu style — a style of his own creation — has over two decades of experience across Karate, Wrestling, Boxing, Wing Chun, Bodybuilding, TRX and CrossFit, making him one of the most well-rounded martial arts masters in Iran. He is the author of "Qigong the Authentic Chinese Kung Fu Way (Wu Wei)" and heads the Wushu Federation of West Karaj.

corrective.title: Corrective Exercise
corrective.sub: Returning the body to its natural alignment — based on Sifu Shayanfar's book
corrective.intro: Corrective exercise is the science of re-educating the body: targeted drills that release shortened muscles, awaken weak ones, and restore natural joint alignment. At Raad Sports Academy this science is combined with Qigong, Dantian breathing and acupressure, so structural correction and mental calm happen together.
